potential.name: awsem-2015
potential.provenance: Published AWSEM-MD (2015) gamma tables from AWSEM_2015.json (AWSEM-MD(2015) gamma), reordered from the AWSEM alphabet onto this package's. Contact and burial terms only; the electrostatic term is not implemented.

note: Interface geometry taken from the crystal ternary complex with the glue deleted. Upper bound on what the hypothesis can show; not a prospective prediction.

stratified.note: Difference in mean frustration, proximal minus distal, computed inside density bands and pooled by band size. Controls for a glue sitting in the interface core.
